title: Beyond Algorithmic Bias: A Socio-Computational Interrogation of the Google Search by Image Algorithm
reasoning: The paper's entire theoretical and methodological framework is centered on evaluating the ethics and sociopolitical impact of an algorithm. It uses social theory (Bourdieu) and ethnographic practices to critique the reproduction of social hierarchies and proposes 'socio-algorithmic justice' as a design goal, which constitutes a deep interrogation of morals and ethics in technology.
